text.p: Grain and oilseed exports reported by USDA and private export sources.

WHEAT SALES - A South Korean buyers group known as the Big Feed Mills bought 52,500 tonnes of Canadian feed wheat at $137 a tonne C&F from Daewoo Corp. Shipment was set for July 27-August 15 to the western ports of Inchon and Kunsan.

- Japan's Food Agency said on Thursday it bought 40,000 tonnes of U.S. wheat and 20,000 tonnes of U.S. feed barley in its weekly tender, all for August shipment. The U.S. wheat comprised 27,000 tonnes of dark northern spring and 13,000 tonnes of hard red winter.

WHEAT TENDERS - South Korea's Cheiljedang Corp and Dongah Flour Mills Co Ltd have jointly invited tenders to buy 21,500 tonnes of U.S. No.1 wheat on Friday. Of the total, Cheiljedang would buy 8,500 tonnes at basis prices over September futures on U.S. grain futures exchanges. Dongah Flour would seek the remaining 13,000 tonnes at fixed prices. Shipment was set for July 20-August 20 to the southeastern port of Pusan.
- The CCC said it was tendering on June 17 for up to 5,080 tonnes of U.S. hard red winter wheat for export to Kenya. Shipment was slated for July 1-25.

WHEAT TENDERS (cont.) - The CCC said it is tendering on June 19 for up to 40,000 tonnes of U.S. hard red winter wheat for export to Armenia. The wheat was slated for June 30-July 15 shipment. The tender was in combination with another for 1,500 to 2,000 tonnes of U.S. hard red winter wheat under the PL-480 program, Title One. Shipment on the second tender was also June 30-July 15 with offers also due on June 19.

- Guyana was tendering on Thursday for 2,300 tonnes of spring wheat, 1,000 tonnes of soft red winter and 3,000 tonnes of hard red winter under the PL-480 program, agents for the buyer said. Shipment was slated for July 4-26.

FEED TENDER - A South Korean buyers group known as the Feed Buying Group has invited tenders to buy 29,500 tonnes of rapeseed meal by 3:00 p.m. (0600 GMT) on Friday. The buyers group has also invited tenders for 8,600 tonnes of cottonseed meal, 8,000 tonnes of tapioca hard pellet and 3,000 tonnes of wheat bran pellet. Arrival dates ranged from July 10 to October 20.
RICE TENDER - The Rice Export Corp of Pakistan invited bids by June 16 for the sale and export of 5,000 tonnes of basmati variety Pak-7 1996/97 (July-June) rice containing seven percent broken.

VEGOIL AND TALLOW TENDERS - El Salvador seeks 4,500 tonnes prime bleachable summer yellow cottonseed oil in bulk and about 1,000 tonnes of sunflowerseed oil under the PL-480 export program for July 20-August 5 shipment. Offers are to be received by June 16. El Salvador also seeks on June 16 about 1,650 tonnes of tallow and 800 tonnes of top white tallow. Shipment dates were set for July 20-August 5.

CORN TENDER - Privatised Egyptian Starch and Glucose said it was seeking 10,000 tonnes +/- 25 percent buyers option of yellow corn of Egyptian, U.S. or Argentinian origin. The firm said the deadline for bids was Thursday, June 12.
CORN/BARLEY TENDER - The Cyprus Grain Commission said it invited tenders for 18,000 tonnes of corn and 25,000 tonnes of barley for shipment in July. The tenders close June 17.
MARKET TALK - The Ukrainian government has ruled that traders will not be banned from exporting grain in 1997, Deputy Prime Minister Serhiy Tyhypko said.
The European Union on Thursday reduced an allocation for preferential maize imports to Spain to 550,000 tonnes from an initial level of 800,000 tonnes, member country officials said.
